entries.title: Micah 7:1
segments: ¶Woe is me! for I am as when they have gathered the summer fruits, as the grapegleanings of the vintage: [there is] no cluster to eat: my soul desired the firstripe fruit. {when...: Heb. the gatherings of summer}

words.text: is me! for I am as when they have gathered

entries.title: Micah 7:2
segments: The good [man] is perished out of the earth: and [there is] none upright among men: they all lie in wait for blood; they hunt every man his brother with a net. {good: or, godly, or, merciful}

entries.title: Micah 7:3
segments: That they may do evil with both hands earnestly, the prince asketh, and the judge [asketh] for a reward; and the great [man], he uttereth his mischievous desire: so they wrap it up. {his...: Heb. the mischief of his soul}

words.text: . {his...: Heb. the mischief of his soul}

entries.title: Micah 7:4
segments: The best of them [is] as a brier: the most upright [is sharper] than a thorn hedge: the day of thy watchmen [and] thy visitation cometh; now shall be their perplexity.

entries.title: Micah 7:5
segments: Trust ye not in a friend, put ye not confidence in a guide: keep the doors of thy mouth from her that lieth in thy bosom.

entries.title: Micah 7:6
segments: For the son dishonoureth the father, the daughter riseth up against her mother, the daughter in law against her mother in law; a man's enemies [are] the men of his own house.

entries.title: Micah 7:7
segments: ¶Therefore I will look unto the LORD; I will wait for the God of my salvation: my God will hear me.

entries.title: Micah 7:8
segments: Rejoice not against me, O mine enemy: when I fall, I shall arise; when I sit in darkness, the LORD [shall be] a light unto me.

words.text: not against me, O mine enemy

entries.title: Micah 7:9
segments: I will bear the indignation of the LORD, because I have sinned against him, until he plead my cause, and execute judgment for me: he will bring me forth to the light, [and] I shall behold his righteousness.

words.text: for me: he will bring me forth

entries.title: Micah 7:10
segments: Then [she that is] mine enemy shall see [it], and shame shall cover her which said unto me, Where is the LORD thy God? mine eyes shall behold her: now shall she be trodden down as the mire of the streets. {Then...: or, And thou wilt see her that is mine enemy, and cover her with shame} {shall she...: Heb. she shall be for a treading down}

words.text: unto me, Where is the LORD
her: now shall she be trodden down
. {Then...: or, And thou wilt see her that is mine enemy, and cover her with shame} {shall she...: Heb. she shall be for a treading down}

entries.title: Micah 7:11
segments: [In] the day that thy walls are to be built, [in] that day shall the decree be far removed.

entries.title: Micah 7:12
segments: [In] that day [also] he shall come even to thee from Assyria, and [from] the fortified cities, and from the fortress even to the river, and from sea to sea, and [from] mountain to mountain. {and [from] the fortified cities: or, even to the fortified cities}

words.text: . {and [from] the fortified cities: or, even to the fortified cities}

entries.title: Micah 7:13
segments: Notwithstanding the land shall be desolate because of them that dwell therein, for the fruit of their doings. {Notwithstanding: or, After that it hath been}

words.text: . {Notwithstanding: or, After that it hath been}

entries.title: Micah 7:14
segments: ¶Feed thy people with thy rod, the flock of thine heritage, which dwell solitarily [in] the wood, in the midst of Carmel: let them feed [in] Bashan and Gilead, as in the days of old. {Feed: or, Rule}

entries.title: Micah 7:15
segments: According to the days of thy coming out of the land of Egypt will I shew unto him marvellous [things].

entries.title: Micah 7:16
segments: The nations shall see and be confounded at all their might: they shall lay [their] hand upon [their] mouth, their ears shall be deaf.

entries.title: Micah 7:17
segments: They shall lick the dust like a serpent, they shall move out of their holes like worms of the earth: they shall be afraid of the LORD our God, and shall fear because of thee. {worms: or, creeping things}

words.text: because of thee. {worms: or, creeping things}

entries.title: Micah 7:18
segments: Who [is] a God like unto thee, that pardoneth iniquity, and passeth by the transgression of the remnant of his heritage? he retaineth not his anger for ever, because he delighteth [in] mercy.

entries.title: Micah 7:19
segments: He will turn again, he will have compassion upon us; he will subdue our iniquities; and thou wilt cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.

entries.title: Micah 7:20
segments: Thou wilt perform the truth to Jacob, [and] the mercy to Abraham, which thou hast sworn unto our fathers from the days of old.
